River Rafting

Tackle the exhilarating rapids of the Ganges with our expert guides! Our thrilling river rafting adventures in Rishikesh offer an unforgettable blend of adrenaline and breathtaking Himalayan scenery. Perfect for both beginners and seasoned rafters, this is your chance to conquer the waves and create lasting memories.

Learn more

Camping

Camping: Experience the serene beauty of Rishikesh under a canopy of stars! Our camping experiences offer the perfect escape into nature, complete with comfortable tents, crackling bonfires, and delicious meals. Wake up to the sound of birds and the fresh mountain air, ready for a day of adventure or relaxation.

Learn more

Scooty on Rent

Conquer the canyons? Our scooty rental experience in Rishikesh offers an unparalleled freedom, propelling you from city bustle into the embrace of the mountains. With top-notch maintenance and straightforward booking, it's an exploration you'll recount for years to come.

Learn more

River Rafting in Rishikesh

Unleash your adventurous spirit on the thrilling rapids of Rishikesh! Our river rafting expeditions on the holy Ganges River offer an unparalleled rush, navigating exhilarating Grade III and IV rapids. Led by certified guides, you'll experience heart-pounding action and stunning scenery, all while ensuring your safety is our top priority. From challenging waves to serene stretches, every moment is an epic journey.

Whether you’re a first-timer or an experienced rafter, get ready for the ride of a lifetime. Book now and make waves with us!

Learn more
01

Your Safety, Our Priority

Paddle with peace of mind. Our certified guides are highly trained in river safety and first aid, ensuring a secure and thrilling adventure for everyone.
02

Guided by Experience

Trust our seasoned experts to lead your journey. With years of experience on the Ganges, they know every rapid and turn, making your trip both safe and exciting.
03

Affordable Price

Experience the best of Rishikesh rafting without breaking the bank. We offer premium adventures at competitive prices, proving that epic memories don't have to be expensive.

Things to carry while Rafting

  • Quick-drying shorts or swimming costume, and T-shirt.
  • Sunglasses, Sunscreen Lotion, and Antiseptic Cream.
  • Extra Undergarments and Towel.
  • Swimming Goggles, Sneakers, or Floaters.
  • Plastic Bags for wet things.
  • Must Keep Waterproof Bag for Camera and other devices.
  • Energy Drinks / Energy Bars in Zip Lock Waterproof Bags.
  • Must Carry Woolen clothes during winters.
  • Use mosquito repellents and lotions during camping.

Rafting Points Rishikesh

Brahmapuri to NIM Beach

Main Rapids : Body Surfing, Initiation, Double Trouble. Rafting Distance : 9 Kms

Clubhouse to NIM Beach

Main Rapids : Clubhouse, Butterfly, Body Surfing, Initiation and Double Trouble. Rafting Distance : 12 Kms

Shivpuri to NIM Beach

Main Rapids : Return to Sender, Roller Coaster, Golf Course, Club House, Initiation, Body Surfing, Double Trouble.

Marine Drive to NIM Beach

Main Rapids : Three Blind Mice, Black Money, Cross Fire, Return to Sender, Roller Coaster, Golf Course, Club House, Initiation, Body Surfing,  Double Trouble. Rafting Distance : 24 Kms

Testimonials

The price justifies the joy, the instructor was very playful with us and explained everything very carefully, he was supportive. You just have to book your ticket and everything will be managed by them. It was wonderful!!! "

I recommend this for river rafting. We enjoyed a lot and captain was very cool and helpful. He took care of us and very good presence’s of mind during rafting.
